system.description: Mystics receive experience from treasure only if they donate it to the needy. Also, they must donate (tithe) ten percent of their treasure to their cloister. Prime Requisite: Strength and Dexterity. Other Requirements: Wisdom and Dexterity scores of 13 or better. Experience Bonus: 5% for Strength 13-15, 10% for Strength 16-18. Hit Dice: 1d6 per level up to 9th level. Starting with 10th level, +2 hit points per level, and Constitution adjustments no longer apply. A mystic's oath is his bond. He must be true to his oath and strive to repay all debts.
